text:
maria: Hey, noticed a weird prefetch bug in console-proxy — when quick-switching orgs some prefetched org metadata from the previous org shows up for ~200ms in the UI. Repro: open org A -> trigger sidebar prefetch -> quick-switch to org B -> see A's names/counts on B.

josh: whoa. which service logs are we looking at? console-proxy or the downstream cache?

maria: console-proxy. grabbing logs now, minimal PII but org names + saved-search titles. snippet below.

maria: ```
proxy GET /api/v1/preview?route=sidebar
headers: { "x-org-id": "67890", "x-session": "abc" }
cache-key: prefetch:sidebar:org:12345 -> HIT
```

kevin: that cache-key looks wrong — it's still using org:12345 even though the request header is 67890. sounds like prefetch key gen is using the last request's context instead of the current one.

rita: any risk of token leakage or user creds?

maria: not seeing tokens. payloads are org metadata and saved search names/counts. It happened briefly during a canary rollout window (prod, ~1 minute).

josh: did deploy-bot show a canary around the time?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T10:12:05 -> console-proxy v2.14.1 rolled 30% canary

kevin: I remember a namespace fix for prefetch keys that wasn't applied in the proxy layer. Likely a race where request context is mutated and reused for async prefetch tasks.

maria: telemetry also shows a handful of requests billed to the wrong tenant for ~2m (quota/usage mapping mismatch).

rita: ok mitigation: disable prefetch for quick-switch route until we patch. Ops, please flip runtime flag console.prefetch.enabled=false for canary and prod immediately.

josh: +1. Kevin, can you put up a minimal fix and tests? Add an e2e for quick-switch.

kevin: on it. I'll namespace cache keys by injecting current org id into the prefetch task and make the context immutable. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console-proxy/pull/412 (adds org-scoped cache key + unit/e2e).

kevin: pushing patch to canary now.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T10:28:40 -> console-proxy v2.14.2 canary 30%

maria: monitoring: no further cross-org payloads observed after patch for 10m. telemetry corrected. filing incident INC-2026-039 to track follow-up and customer outreach.

josh: thanks. follow-ups: postmortem, add rollout UX note about prefetched state, and add an integration test in the release gating job. :thumbsup:

kevin: will do — note in PR and add to release checklist.

rita: leaving a quick ops play in the incident ticket: runtime flag toggle, rate-limit prefetch, and alert on cache-hits-with-mismatched-org-header.

maria: filing alerts now. thanks all.
